name: Aliso Niguel Summer 2024
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlisoNiguelSummer2024#38894-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png)
